title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 00:00 UTC on 3 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 3 日 00:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 00:00 UTC on 3 October 2026. The 00:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 00:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 0.00/0Z). Last-180 maximum is 1.67 (first at 2026-10-02T23:57:00Z; label 2M). Published-window maximum is 1.67 (first at 2026-10-02T23:57:00Z; label 2M). Window start 2026-10-02T19:56:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 01:00 UTC on 3 October 2026 hour is still incomplete (54 samples through 01:53).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
